The ball mill process was conducted at 300 rpm for 6 h under an inert atmosphere.

The alloy powder was sintered in a spark plasma sintering (SPS, SPS-60) furnace under a vacuum of less than 10^-2 Pa. ... A pre-pressure of 10 MPa was applied ... The temperature was initially increased at a rate of 100 °C/min until reached 1000 °C, then maintained at a slower rate of 50 °C/min until the sintering temperature of 1350 °C was reached. Once the sintering temperature was reached, the pressure was increased to 30 MPa, and the sample was held at that temperature for 10 min. After the holding time, the sample was cooled in the furnace.
